approach: Create crates/athena-data/src/history.rs with six record structs (LandingIntent, Landing, DeclaredIntervention, Checkpoint, LegacyExempt, ImportManifest), a separate internally tagged HistoryRecord enum (tag "schema", deny_unknown_fields) with parse and validate, and tests. Do not touch AnyRecord. Export the module in lib.rs, add a doc pointer in records.rs, and add a CHANGELOG entry. Cargo.toml changes only if a need appears.

decisions.choice: Schema tags athena.landing-intent/1, athena.landing/1, athena.declared-intervention/1, athena.checkpoint/1, athena.legacy-exempt/1, athena.import-manifest/1; Rust type DeclaredIntervention.
decisions.reason: records.rs already has athena.intervention/1 and InterventionCategory; reuse would collide. Design §5.3 calls it 'intervention (declared)'.

rejected.why: Collides with the existing record and its tests.

decisions.choice: Separate HistoryRecord enum in history.rs, not new AnyRecord variants.
decisions.reason: AnyRecord drives records/ routing and the history check, which must not change.

rejected.why: Touches existing exhaustive matches and risks changing history-check behaviour.

decisions.choice: Local sha (40 lowercase hex) and SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex) validators; no new dependency.
decisions.reason: One-line checks; buy-first does not justify a crate.

decisions.choice: Fields as in criterion 4; merge method is an enum (squash, merge, rebase) in snake_case; reuse JobId, RecordId and jiff Timestamp.

files.purpose: Six record types, HistoryRecord enum, validators and tests.
Add pub mod history and a crate doc bullet.
Doc-only pointer to history.rs; no behaviour change.
Entry naming the six record types.
Listed deliverable; expected unchanged unless a dependency is needed.

steps: Read the top of CHANGELOG.md and the id module (JobId, RecordId) for conventions.

Create history.rs: sha and sha256 validators, six structs with deny_unknown_fields and doc comments citing the design and D111, the HistoryRecord enum with schema tags and schema(), parse and validate.
Implement per-struct validate(): non-empty trimmed strings, 40-hex shas, non-empty lists, PR number > 0.
Add tests: round trip, schema tag in text, rejection of empty field, unknown field, bad sha, wrong tag, and an athena.intervention/1 body.
Add pub mod history to lib.rs and a doc pointer in records.rs.
Run cargo fmt, clippy --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace.

risks.risk: Name or schema clash with the existing intervention record.
risks.mitigation: Use athena.declared-intervention/1 and a separate enum; a test asserts an athena.intervention/1 body is rejected.

risks.risk: Accidental change to the history check or records routing.
risks.mitigation: Leave AnyRecord alone; grep confirms no other crate uses history.

risks.risk: Sha validation too loose or strict.
risks.mitigation: Tests assert exactly 40 lowercase hex and reject uppercase.

demonstrations.method: Six unit tests: build a valid value, serialize to pretty JSON, assert the text has the schema tag, parse with HistoryRecord::parse, assert equality.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the schema tag or serde derives, the text lacks the tag or the parsed value differs or fails to parse.

demonstrations.method: Rejection tests per type: empty required field, unknown JSON field, sha uppercase/short/non-hex, wrong schema tag, and an athena.intervention/1 body; valid examples return Ok.
demonstrations.observes: Err for each malformed case, Ok for each valid example.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without validate(), empty fields and bad shas are accepted; without deny_unknown_fields, the unknown field parses.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets and cargo fmt --check; use git diff to confirm existing test code is unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: All three pass, and the existing records and history-check tests run and pass unmodified.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the change broke the existing records or history-check behaviour (for example by adding AnyRecord variants or editing shared helpers), those existing tests would fail. A lint, format or compile error in the new code would fail clippy, fmt or the test build.

demonstrations.observes: Every pub item has a doc comment citing docs/design/records-history.md (§5.3, §4 or §8) and D111, and the field sets match the design list.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the changed-file list and check history.rs for git or branch code.
demonstrations.observes: Only the deliverable files change; there is no writer or host-check code; nothing under athena-core, athena-cli, athena-gate or records/ changed.
A new entry names landing-intent, landing, intervention, checkpoint, legacy-exempt and import-manifest in athena-data.

open_questions: Exact CHANGELOG heading format was not read; follow the file's top entries.
Merge method enum versus free string: the design only says 'the merge method'; the plan uses an enum.
Cargo.toml is listed but no change is expected.
